name: Writing Assistant (Conductor)
description: Embeds the hosted Conductor SEO/AI writing assistant as a Drupal Canvas extension. Ships a front-end app plus a credentialed Drupal-side proxy to the Conductor API (api.conductor.com), maps Canvas entities to Conductor draft UUIDs in a local table with a per-year quota, and provides a drafts dashboard and opt-in cron cleanup. Conductor credentials (api_key + shared_secret JSON) are held in a Key entity.
project_description:
Acquia SEO Content Insights module, powered by Conductor is designed to make the day-to-day lives of marketing teams easier.

 Optimize content with SEO best practices and target high-value keywords to improve organic search performance, increase site traffic, and ensure your digital presence captivates a broader audience. Acquia SEO provides content teams with actionable insights, real-time recommendations, and performance analytics that demystify the content optimization process, making it easy to iterate continuously and drive continuous content performance improvements across platforms and search engines.

 🔎 Discover insights around page performance and new topic opportunities

📈 Uncover content optimizations to improve visibility and performance

👍 Take action and collaborate more efficiently across teams

 Make impactful changes to your content by leveraging the best of Conductor right in Drupal's node edit form. Conductor is available to anyone with a Conductor account. Perform keyword research and better understand how your content is optimized for Search.

 API Key 
 You will need to obtain an API key and enter it on the module's configuration page. You can obtain an API key by following this link:

 https://www.conductor.com/lp/content-insights-drupal/
